title: Live v2.5 09 SP7 - Seeded chance
description: SP7 live fixture: a hall where the rules pick the speaker by weight (D4b), a gate whose onEnter NPC reply rolls at 0.5 (D4), and a code roll quality drawn at gate entry that decides which way the gate goes (D5 machinery).

qualities.rubric: Has the party walked up to the old gate?
Has the party tried to open the old gate?
Does the old lock give way this visit?

checkpoints.name: The Hall
checkpoints.objective: The party waits in the hall before walking to the old gate.

checkpoints.name: The Old Gate
checkpoints.objective: The party stands before the old gate and may try the lock.

npc_replies.text: Arin runs a hand over the rusted lock.

checkpoints.name: Through the Gate
checkpoints.objective: The lock gave way and the party is through.

checkpoints.name: Barred
checkpoints.objective: The lock held and the party must find another way.
